name: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part III : NightFall
source:
Taking place immediately after "No Regrets", William is freed from The Council's "Happy Glowstick Funtime Re-education Camp" by some mysterious friends.

Meanwhile, Grendel's mother comes across some unwanted plans regarding the demise of the protagonist and sets out to stop it.  Unfortunately though, she needs the help of the protagonist

As the years roll by, William and his friends eventually launch an attack, cumulating in the death of Grendel's father. 

With The Council's power systems failing, the protagonist is forced into destroying The Council Of The Unseen.  However, further surprises await inside...
